title: Body Part Match
intro: Match structures to their jobs, then trace how an animal senses danger or food and responds.
note: This is a model. The ruler-drop test in the lesson measures a real reaction.
summary: Structures have jobs: some hold up or protect, some take in or make what the living thing needs, and some sense information. Information goes from a sense organ to the brain, and the brain sends a response to the muscles.

stages.prompt: What job does each structure do?

bins.label: Takes in or makes what the living thing needs

cards.label: Tree bark
cards.why: Bark protects the inside of a tree.
cards.hint: it covers the outside of the trunk.

cards.label: Rose thorns
cards.why: Thorns protect a plant from animals that would eat it.

cards.label: Plant roots
cards.why: Roots take in water and minerals from the soil.
cards.hint: what do they take in from the ground?

cards.label: Leaves
cards.why: Leaves use light to make food for the plant.
cards.hint: what do they use light to make?

cards.label: Eyes
cards.why: Eyes sense light and send that information to the brain.

cards.label: Ears
cards.why: Ears sense sound and send the information to the brain.

cards.label: Nose
cards.why: A nose senses smells and sends the information to the brain.

stages.prompt: Follow the path: a deer hears a snap and a robin sees a worm. Where does each step happen?

cards.label: The deer's ears hear a snap
cards.why: The ears take in the sound. That is information coming in.
cards.hint: is this the part that takes in information?

cards.label: The robin's eyes see a worm
cards.why: The eyes take in light from the worm.
cards.hint: is this the part that takes in information?

cards.label: The brain decides: danger
cards.why: The brain uses the information to decide what to do.

cards.label: The brain decides: food
cards.why: The brain uses the information to decide what to do.

cards.label: The deer's leg muscles run
cards.why: The brain sends the message to the muscles and the deer runs away.

cards.label: The robin hops and grabs the worm
cards.why: The brain sends the message to the muscles and the robin grabs the worm.
